preconditions.description: Attacker must have some balance of the Arche token (FFI_ERC20) to participate in swaps
The D_Swap contract must have sufficient liquidity for the token being swapped

exploit_hint: The Impl_Delivery() function violates checks-effects-interactions pattern by making external calls before updating state. Create a malicious contract that calls back into the vulnerable function during the token transfer. Use a reentrancy attack to drain ETH from the contract by repeatedly calling Impl_Delivery() before the contract's balance is updated.
